Reason for Mistake: The Filmography_Expert made an error by including the film "Subway" (1985), which has a runtime of 104 minutes (1 hour and 44 minutes), as part of the filtered list of films with runtimes of less than 2 hours. Films with runtimes that equal or exceed 2 hours (120 minutes) should not be part of this list. "Subway" fits the criteria correctly; however, the mistake lies in not considering films less than 2 hours beyond the initial list, such as "Nosferatu the Vampyre", which meets the criteria, is available on Vudu, and has a higher IMDb rating. This initial oversight led to downstream errors when checking platform availability and ratings, ultimately providing an incomplete answer.
